autograd.description: Owns autograd engine behavior, gradient recording and execution, and Python autograd APIs.

flex_attention.description: Owns FlexAttention kernels, score and mask modification behavior, and FlexAttention integration.

nn.description: Owns neural-network modules, module behavior, and user-facing torch.nn APIs.

testcase_refactoring.description: Owns PRs whose main purpose is making PyTorch tests reusable across hardware backends, including out-of-tree and PrivateUse1 accelerators: converting CUDA-hardcoded tests to device-generic tests (instantiate_device_type_tests, device parameters, torch.accelerator APIs), adding or correcting hw_classification / HardwareClassification on test classes, replacing device-specific skips with capability-based gating, and the shared device-generic test infrastructure in torch/testing/_internal (DeviceTypeTestBase hooks, get_capabilities). Does not own PRs that fix, skip, or change tolerances or expected results of tests for one specific device, such as a CUDA-only test failure, or tests that accompany a product-code change.
